feeds.title: HipHop Over Everything Blog
feeds.description: HipHop Over Everything in Atlanta, Georgia, offers marketing and promotion packages for independent hip-hop music artists. Turn up your exposure with us. We are always working hard to make sure that the indie and underground artists are being heard, and exposed. We would welcome the opportunity to earn your trust and deliver you the best service in the industry.

feeds.title: Rap Fiesta Blog
feeds.description: Our goal is to spread beautiful indie Hip-Hop far and wide. We want the world to enjoy the music we find, and to share that bond with others. We do so by providing them information from professionals that have done it themselves. We frequently bring on managers, stylists, music lawyers and any other moving piece in the industry, to educate on these topics...
